'Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack' on a 2H Club weapon. Shape copied from .drafts/ball_breaker.json, whose printed text is word-for-word identical ('Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack', same ClassicBattles set), which in turn copies shipped cru/sledge_of_anvilheim.json (ACTIVATE + activation_cost + ATTACK).

The ability is DECLARATIVE: the engine already offers the weapon's attack itself via play._add_weapon_attacks from printed power + parsed activation cost, and enforces once-per-turn via has_per_turn_limit/weapon_exhausted. The ATTACK effect mainly declares the ability (satisfies the must-implement-something check) and builds the attack proxy for any context that invokes it directly; play._add_hero_dsl_activations deliberately skips ATTACK-effect abilities so it never double-fires (effect_types.py:5139-5149). activation_cost sits on the ABILITY (sledge_of_anvilheim spelling) and per_turn: 1 at card level per DSL_REFERENCE; the resource cost is NOT also modelled as a PAY_RESOURCES cost, which would double-charge.

Blade Break is not on this card - printed_keywords is empty - so there is nothing else to author.
